items.title: A Multi-Criteria Innovation Framework for Green Financial Product Design
items.text: A blueprint for sustainable finance to speed the green transition in emerging markets. Centred on Bangladesh, it designs context-specific green financial products — rather than copying Western models — using a multi-criteria lens that fuses AHP and TOPSIS to balance financial viability, environmental impact and social inclusion.

items.title: Deploying Data-Driven Tools to Monitor and Enhance Learning Outcomes in Schools
items.text: Advanced monitoring and analytics are used to assess how climate and disaster risks affect student performance. Findings show that real-time data integration enables targeted interventions.

items.title: Bangladesh’s ESG Transition in 2025: Why It Lags India, Vietnam & ASEAN Peers
items.text: By examining multiple sectors, we uncover how embedding sustainability across operations delivers tangible economic, social and environmental returns.

items.title: Transforming BMDF into a Next-Gen Municipal Financing Institution
items.text: IP3 led a transformation roadmap — redesigning governance, introducing innovative finance tools (PPPs, bonds), building institutional capacity and embedding a 10-year business plan.
